answer: Require each agent identity to be rooted in a basalt-hard device key bound to a hardware enclave, so one machine cannot mint thousands of fake agents cheaply. New identities start in a slow, glacier-paced probation garden: they earn reputation only by completing publicly auditable useful work, and each completed task is checked by several independent verifiers. A sybil army then costs real hardware plus weeks of verifiable work per identity, while one honest agent pays almost nothing.
